scope: Direct native instance preparation from indexed body poses and local render descriptors, with tight 3/9/4-float output strides.
tolerance_reason: Native f32 quaternion composition and matrix construction; exact descriptor colors, guards and readonly words.
preconditions: Bounded native descriptor pose indices; unit body/local quaternions; finite translations and signed/zero/nonuniform scale.
invariants: Shared and reversed body indices are read-only; each instance owns its tightly packed output region.
Colors preserve all bits including negative zero. Deformation columns are independently checked for the requested scales and orthogonality.
